fixed.detail: Revision-driven updates, batched notifications, serialized/coalesced queries, unchanged-render suppression, explicit online refresh with cooldown, deadlines, startup recovery and teardown cancellation.

Detached occurrence IDs, out-of-range moved overrides, multiple/zoned/UTC EXDATEs, floating local time, date-only TZID handling, implicit all-day duration, zero-duration boundary occurrences and widened recurrence query bounds.

Missing +N indicator count when event-max is below available space; untrusted event color strings sanitized before inline CSS; tooltip monitor chosen from pointer; removed instances cannot reclaim input.
Smooth touchpad navigation; midnight respects retained-view preference; missing module errors do not arm a failing day timer.
Corrected fallback week starts against CLDR 48 and stopped locale extension keys being mistaken for regions.
Malformed or out-of-range timestamps skipped instead of building invalid day entries.
Settings page/section titles, units, untitled event fallback and AM/PM included in translation path; POT strings escape multiline content and generated catalog is validated before replacing it.

Required-file/JSON validation and staging before replacing existing installation; rollback on replacement failure; prior installation retained; custom files preserved; symlink replacement refused; XDG paths honored.
Malformed/non-string enabled-desklets values fail closed; existing order and positions preserved; safe IDs; removal aborts if settings cannot be updated.
One installer path for deploy/install; native Cinnamon reload checked for new ready instance; no blanket error suppression or full-list toggling; unknown/excess arguments rejected.
Compile into temporary file before replacing a valid translation; retain prior binary on invalid translation; uninstall removes only this desklet translation domain and preserves settings.
Restore parent/position/style on failure and interruption, ownership protection against simultaneous captures, in-process recovery timer, reject unknown flags and existing outputs.
Validate/build before replacing previous ZIP or Spices tree; verify required library modules; include screenshot referenced by bundled README.

Meaningful shared-date/week assertions replace weak tests; new failure/UI regressions; live test prints counts rather than event details; docs corrected for sync behavior, limitations and installer workflow.
Mouse tools validate arguments and screen bounds; icon tool supports proper usage/help.

remaining.detail: Standalone CJS live-EDS test reads 7 calendars/142 events but exits 139 during native teardown. Minimal script importing only EDataServer/ECal also exits 139; gdb shows GLib main-context callback through libedataserver and GObject unref during CJS shutdown. No Big Calendar code is needed. Not masked as a passing test. Live desklet reload tests pass.

RDATE-only schedules, multiple RRULEs, custom VTIMEZONE definitions and THISANDFUTURE overrides are not fully supported. Expansion stops after 5000 steps, so very old/high-frequency series may be incomplete. Replacing recurrence architecture requires separate agreement.
Dates outside years 1000–9999 are not supported consistently. Weekend tinting remains Saturday/Sunday rather than region-specific weekend definitions.
Browser/phone events still need EDS to download them. Refresh requests do not guarantee immediate provider completion. No global provider polling interval was changed.

Runtime verified on Cinnamon 6.6.9, CJS 115.1 and EDS 3.52.3, one physical X11 monitor. Other supported Cinnamon releases, Wayland, actual multi-monitor displays, every provider and every settings combination were not available for exhaustive validation. Multi-monitor tooltip math has a synthetic regression test.
No .github workflows exist in this project checkout. Added tests run locally; no CI service was introduced or configured.
Calendars remain all-or-nothing; no per-calendar filtering was added.
